We run Selnivo Flow from Cebu City, Philippines, and I need this campaign managed carefully from launch through the final day. Run it from Wednesday, October 20, 2027 through Wednesday, October 27, 2027, inclusive: eight days in Manila time, the account's time zone. The objective is as many free-trial starts as possible. We count trial starts, so keep that outcome central.

The landing page is https://selnivoflow.app/start. Here's the exact copy from our landing page: "Selnivo Flow is a mobility and stretching app for desk workers, with guided three-minute shoulder and hip routines that fit between tasks. Start your seven-day free trial with no payment details required, and set reminders to make movement part of your workday. Available worldwide, exclusively on iPhone (iOS) and Android phones."

Everything is localized: the app and the landing page come in every major language, and we have a version of each post in every market's language, so people everywhere see us in their own language.

The site does not have X's pixel, so X cannot see our trial starts. You may launch and manage the campaign on your own without asking me for approval. Watch it throughout all eight days and make the necessary adjustments. At the end, send me a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks. Keep it concise and be clear about what the results actually show.

Total budget: 950.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 3 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:

Campaign complete — ran all eight days, Oct 20–27 Manila time, and stayed inside budget.

Recap (Oct 20–27, Asia/Manila):
- Spend: $913.57 of $950.00
- Impressions: 2,262,086
- Link clicks: 1,341 (avg $0.68/click)

Setup: one campaign ([Selnivo Flow - Free Trial - Oct 20-27](https://ads.x.com)) with three ad groups, one per approved post, worldwide, iOS + Android only, optimizing for link clicks as the proxy for trial starts. Mid-flight I shifted budget to the winner (chair-hook post) and paused the weakest ad group for the last two days.

Per post:
- Chair-hook post (…9118): $437.61, 1,045,617 impressions, 716 clicks
- Desk-stretch post (…5913): $304.61, 812,850 impressions, 416 clicks
- Shoulder/hip post (…2387): $171.34, 403,619 impressions, 209 clicks

What this actually shows: these are link clicks to https://selnivoflow.app/start, not trial starts. The site has no X pixel, so X cannot see or optimize toward actual trial starts, and I can't report how many clicks converted. No new posts were created; only your three approved posts ran.

One honest caveat: the winning chair-hook post says the least about the app (no mention of desk workers, iOS/Android-only, or no-payment trial), so its clicks are likely the least qualified — volume winner, but probably the lowest trial-start rate of the three.
